dedupe_keys.name: madrid enriched traffic flow road network and weather datasets

description: This Mendeley Data collection combines Madrid traffic-sensor flow with road attributes, calendar and weather context. The describing article reports two traffic datasets covering June 2022 through February 2024 and identifies vehicle counts per hour from urban sensors. The current public version 4 inventory extends the release with compressed source packages, sensor coordinates, road adjacency matrices, temporal sequence arrays, variables and checksums. It is licensed CC BY 4.0. Coverage is selected city roads and sensor periods, not every street or continuously updated live traffic. Missing sensors, weather joins and derived sequences may change which hours and nodes are represented; version 4 should not be assumed identical to the article’s version 1. A reviewer-assessed use is testing traffic-flow or graph-forecasting models in Madrid. data-openstreetmap is a documented road-attribute source, while model-sumo is a related traffic simulator without a verified input conversion. The two article datasets are treated as one repository collection, with no duplicate drafts. No archive, sequence array or map layer was downloaded.
